_note: SOP structured after publicly known fire-response procedure patterns (Delhi Fire Service / NDMA style escalation), not a copy of any specific government document.
title: Structural/Industrial Fire Response SOP v1.3
trigger_conditions: Fire reported at a residential, commercial, or industrial premises
Possible entrapment, casualties, or hazardous-material exposure at the site
auto_approved_actions: Deploy Fire & Rescue Unit to the site for suppression and search
Deploy Rapid Action Team for area cordon and crowd control
Send alert to nearby responder units
requires_human_approval: Deploying Medical/Ambulance Unit to a facility or route flagged as access-blocked
Requesting additional fire tenders beyond the local station's standard response
escalation_rule: If the suppression or casualty-evacuation task remains unresolved 15+ minutes after assignment, escalate to the District Control Room (on-call) and open an approval request if further spend or blocked-route medical deployment is required.
